question.text: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

exchange.sent: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

answer.answer:
### 建議主軸
Focus the Wireless Communication chain on 3GPP/NTN and satellite wireless testing: market needs such as controlled validation, QoS, repeatability, and compatibility with cellular/emerging wireless technologies map to measurable RF parameters such as delay, Doppler, path loss, group delay, ACLR, EVM, BER, spurious emissions, and conformance TMs/FRCs, which then map to R&S SMW200A signal-generation/channel-emulation capabilities and R&S FSW/FSVA3000 signal-analysis capabilities. [40][41][3][24][66]
### 推薦先賣
R&S SMW200A is directly linked to NTN signal generator/channel emulator use, including long path delays, enhanced Doppler capabilities, and customized dynamic fading for 5G NTN-NR testing. [2][3]
R&S FSW and R&S FSVA3000 are directly linked to SAN transmitter measurements, because 3GPP SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter-characteristics measurements require a spectrum analyzer and the source says 5G NR options on FSW/FSVA support those measurements. [24]
R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are directly recommended in the source for complete satellite payload testing, covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality. [42]
### Chain map
| Market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Satellite communication systems must support wireless communications, maintain 24/7 operation, support multi-decade longevity, maintain QoS, and remain compatible with existing cellular networks and emerging wireless technologies. [40] | Payload/component RF testing measures group delay, linearity and gain transfer, modulation accuracy, BER, EVM, OFDM behavior, spurious emissions, noise figure, and gain. [41] | R&S SMW200A is used for multi-carrier/modulated signal generation, OFDM waveform generation, DPD, and NPR stimulus, with key features up to 67 GHz, up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth, up to 4 GHz signal bandwidth with R&S SMW-K555, and optional second RF path up to 44 GHz. [44] | R&S FSW is used for group delay, linearity, NPR, signal quality, spurious, carrier-in-carrier, and oscillator/synthesizer measurements, with key features up to 90 GHz, up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers, up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth, and 800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth. [44] |
| Satellite equipment manufacturers face pressure to reduce test time/cost while uplink and downlink beam counts increase, so the test solution must be straightforward, fast, reproducible, and have high measurement performance and repeatability. [40] | Group delay is used to determine transmission-path phase distortions, channel band-edge distortion, and transmission-path quality. [96] | R&S SMW200A generates a multi-carrier continuous wave stimulus, with tone count and spacing/aperture adjustable to DUT needs, and the source lists R&S SMW-K61 for multicarrier group delay measurement. [25] | R&S FSW performs reference calibration and DUT measurement by determining carrier phase/amplitude and phase difference, and the source lists R&S FSW-K17 for the multicarrier group delay measurement application. [25] |
| 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industry, initially focused on transparent payload in S/L bands and later extensions toward regenerative architecture and other bands. [2] | NTN channel emulation parameters include update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss, with E2E features including longer path delays, enhanced Doppler capabilities, and frequency-dependent atmospheric effects. [3] | R&S SMW200A with firmware version ≥ 5.30 supports B14 or B15, R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modelling, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler. [3] | The E2E NTN channel-emulation source describes SMW200A channel-emulation capabilities but does not assign a corresponding FSW/FSVA analyzer requirement for these E2E delay/Doppler/pathloss parameters. [3] |
| NTN IoT device testing must handle new fading profiles, atmospheric/weather-specific effects, high free-space path loss, and UE-side low SNR. [13] | The source gives measurable low-SNR requirements of minimum SINR ≥ −10 dB and minimum RSRP ≥ −137 dBm. [13] | R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading uses key parameters update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss, and the E2E features include frequency-dependent atmospheric effects. [3] | The NTN IoT device-testing requirement source provides SINR/RSRP and fading/path-loss requirements, but it does not state a specific signal-analyzer option or measurement configuration for them. [13] |
| SAN conformance testing targets a Satellite Access Node in transparent payload architecture and links NR SAN testing to 3GPP TS 38.108 and 3GPP TS 38.181. [23][91] | SAN transmitter TMs measure SAN output power/radiated transmit power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, operating-band unwanted emissions, transmitter spurious emissions, EVM, total power dynamic range, and frequency error. [89] | R&S SMW200A SAN testing features include FRCs, TMs, Fading Module, AWGN Module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, NB-IoT options K119/K115/K143/K146, NR options K144/K148/K171, and B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation. [92] | Chapter 6 conducted transmitter characteristics and Chapter 9 radiated transmitter characteristics require a spectrum analyzer, and 5G NR options on R&S FSW/R&S FSVA3000 support Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements. [24] |
| SAN receiver and performance conformance testing uses Fixed Reference Channels for receiver characterization and performance measurements. [89] | SAN FRC-based measurements include receiver sensitivity level, ACS, dynamic range, performance requirements, and PRACH test preambles. [89] | SMW B10/B14 is stated for testing needs up to 160 MHz and SMW B9/B15 for testing needs up to 200 MHz, both with support for receiver and performance characteristics, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO. [92] | The cited SAN receiver/performance passages specify the SMW signal-generation side, while the cited analyzer support is explicitly for transmitter Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements. [24][92] |
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S SMW200A Signal Generator / Channel Emulator | 5G NTN-NR testing requires long path delays, enhanced Doppler, customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modelling, and atmospheric effects. [2][3] | Firmware version ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15, R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading, up to 1073 ms delay, up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler, update interval/delay/Doppler/pathloss parameters. [3] | It directly implements the NTN channel-emulation parameters needed to turn satellite movement and propagation behavior into controlled lab fading files and RF impairments. [3] | [2][3] | The source is a 2025 presentation/solution summary, not a formal datasheet or price-book configuration, and recommended configurations are not a quote-ready BOM. [64] |
| R&S SMW200A for SAN signal generation | SAN conformance receiver/performance testing needs FRCs, TMs, fading, AWGN, propagation models, TDL/moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, delay, and residual Doppler support. [92] | NB-IoT options K119/K115/K143/K146, NR options K144/K148/K171, B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation, SMW B10/B14 up to 160 MHz, and SMW B9/B15 up to 200 MHz. [92] | It is explicitly described as the core signal generator/channel emulator for SAN conformance testing tied to 3GPP TS 38.108 and TS 38.181. [90][92] | [90][92] | The SAN source is a 2025 presentation, and the source warns that recommended configurations omit price, calibration, accessories, service contract, export control, and latest availability. [88] |
| R&S FSW / R&S FSVA3000 Signal Analyzer | SAN transmitter conformance requires conducted and radiated transmitter-characteristics measurements. [24] | 5G NR options on R&S FSW/R&S FSVA3000 support Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements; R&S FSW signal-analysis software includes LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 K171, OFDM signal analysis K96, and Vector Signal Analysis K70. [24][66] | SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 explicitly require a spectrum analyzer, and the measured items include output power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, EVM, and frequency error. [24][89] | [24][66][89] | The source notes that the FSW/FSVA 5G NR options support Chapter 6 and Chapter 9, but it does not list an FSVA3000 model or full option stack. [58] |
| R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A complete payload testing | Satellite systems need fast, reproducible testing with high measurement performance and repeatability for payloads/components. [40] | R&S SMW-K61 and R&S FSW-K17 are listed for multicarrier group delay measurement, and R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended for complete payload testing. [25][27] | The pair supports group delay measurement by generating a multicarrier stimulus and analyzing carrier phase/amplitude differences, and complete payload testing covers group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality. [25][42] | [25][42] | The group-delay accuracy and benefits come from an application brochure, and actual performance depends on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option, and calibration setup. [93] |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| NTN end-to-end RF satellite link emulation | R&S SMW200A with firmware ≥ 5.30, B14/B15, R&S SMW-K820, and optionally R&S Space Nexus fading files. [3] | Sell the chain from satellite trajectory to measurable update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss, with up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler. [3] | R&S Space Nexus formal version, order number, licensing, output format, and availability conditions are not stated. [59] |
| SAN conformance receiver/performance testing | R&S SMW200A with FRCs, TMs, fading/AWGN, TDL/moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, and relevant NB-IoT/NR options. [92] | Sell the chain from 3GPP TS 38.108/38.181 SAN conformance to FRC/TM-based receiver and performance testing with delay and residual Doppler support for LEO. [91][92] | The presentation does not provide full test case IDs, validation status, uncertainty, or quote-ready configuration details. [88] |
| SAN transmitter measurements | R&S FSW or R&S FSVA3000 with 5G NR options for Chapter 6 and Chapter 9. [24] | Sell the chain from transmitter conformance to spectrum-analyzer measurements of output power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, EVM, and frequency error. [24][89] | The source does not provide a full FSVA3000 option stack or formal configuration details. [58] |
| Satellite payload/component RF characterization | R&S SMW200A + R&S FSW. [42] | Sell the chain from satellite payload QoS/repeatability needs to group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal-quality measurements. [40][42] | The source says actual group-delay performance depends on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option, and calibration setup. [93] |
### 限制
The knowledge base supports Wireless Communication context through a Rohde & Schwarz presentation about EMC/regulatory test for wireless devices with 3GPP cellular technology and through satellite/NTN wireless communication testing passages, but it does not provide a single unified market-requirement document that ranks these requirements. [100][40][2]
The NTN signal-generator solution source is a presentation/solution summary, not a formal datasheet, configuration guide, price book, or standards-compliance statement. [64]
The SAN conformance source is a 2025 presentation and does not provide full test case IDs, software version, validation status, uncertainty, or quote-ready configuration details. [88]

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 重點摘要
此來源是由 `3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown；封面標示 `1GP` 與 `12-2025`，末頁標示 `Last updated: 08/25`，其中 slide 27 另標示 `2025-09-29 Nokia Workshop at R&S - SigGen Product Update`。本頁以來源原文呈現的 2025 年簡報語境處理，不自行推論正式發布日。

簡報主題是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 針對 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 的 signal generator / channel emulation 測試方案，涵蓋：

- [[5G NTN-NR]] 的 Release 17 / 18 / 19 演進與頻段。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）conformance testing。
- [[NTN signal generator solutions]] 的 component testing、SAN testing、end-to-end system testing 與 UE testing 分層。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 channel emulator / signal generator 的 NTN 測試能力。
- [[R&S FSW]] 與 [[R&S FSVA3000]] 在 component testing / SAN transmitter measurement 中的角色。
- [[R&S Space Nexus]] 依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files 的待請求 PC software 線索。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › NTN end-to-end system testing
來源 slide 24–28 說 E2E system testing 會以 channel emulator for service link 與 channel emulator for feeder link 模擬 UE、NTN payload 之間的 RF satellite link。

來源 slide 25 標示 `SMW firmware version ≥ 5.30`，key features 包含：

- Flexible definition of terrestrial channel profiles；B14 or B15 required。
- Customized dynamic fading；K820 required。
- Model satellite trajectory。
- Account for frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- Longer path delays and enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- Up to 1073 ms delay。
- Up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

來源 slide 27 說 [[R&S Space Nexus]] 是 PC Software，available on request，可 generate SMW200A fading files based on a satellite trajectory；key parameters 同為 update interval、delay、Doppler、pathloss。

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing
來源將 E2E system testing 描述為對 UE、NTN payload、service link channel emulator 與 feeder link channel emulator 的 RF satellite link emulation。[[R&S SMW200A]] 需要 firmware version ≥ 5.30，並透過 B14 或 B15 搭配 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading 支援：

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

NTN signal generator solutions › 與 NTN validation / conformance 的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：既有 CMX500 PR 中 propagation emulation 與 fading 的概念；本來源補充 SMW200A dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 實作線索。

NTN signal generator solutions › 來源中的 solution 分層
[[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] 將 NTN testing 分為四類：

- Component Testing。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）Testing。
- End-to-end System Testing。
- User Equipment（UE）Testing。

來源可讀內容主要展開前三者，尤其是 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 channel emulation、[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 與 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › fading and path loss
來源指出 satellite connectivity 除 terrestrial fading profiles 外還需要 new fading profiles，包括 atmospheric fading 與 terrestrial fading 的組合，以及 rain、cloud、sun storms causing electron flow 等 weather-specific effects emulation。Large distance 造成 high free space path loss，導致 UE side low SNR。來源列出：

- Minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB。
- Minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm。
- NTN 第一階段目標為 outdoor connections。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 測試對象與架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 18，測試對象是 Satellite Access Node（DUT），transparent payload architecture。圖中文字包含：

- Gateway。
- NTN Payload RF。
- gNB。
- Feeder Link Emulator。
- Signal generator。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- Throughput measurement point。

來源 slide 6 說 [[3GPP]] Specification Work in Release 17 and Release 18 focuses on transparent bent-pipe payload architecture。SAN provides NR user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards NTN satellite-capable UE，connected via NG interface to 5GC，and encompasses a transparent NTN payload onboard a NTN platform、a gateway and gNB functions。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › OTA in-channel selectivity
- ICS 衡量 receiver 在存在較高 power spectral density interferer 時，於指定 resource block locations 接收 wanted signal 的能力。
- Test purpose：驗證 BS receiver 抑制 IQ leakage 的能力。
- 來源列出 BS type 1-O Wide / Medium / Local area 與 BS type 2-O 的 wanted / interfering signal mean power、SCS、reference measurement channel 與 RB 數。

NTN propagation emulation and fading
[[NTN propagation emulation and fading]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]] 中用來區分 satellite space-to-ground effects 與 terrestrial impairments 的測試概念；來源宣稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 可將兩者分開建模與控制，以支援更 accurate and flexible 的 NTN scenario testing。

NTN propagation emulation and fading › 使用限制
- 來源是 PR，不是 channel model specification、measurement application note 或 formal datasheet。
- 來源未提供 propagation emulation 與 fading 的正式模型名稱、3GPP clause、parameter range、implementation architecture、supported bands、supported orbit profiles 或 calibration method。
- 來源宣稱 only available NTN test solution，但未提供競品清單、比較日期或 benchmark 方法。
- 不可由本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 的正式 fading option、channel emulator 規格、measurement uncertainty 或 conformance coverage。

NTN propagation emulation and fading › 來源中的區分
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[R&S CMX500]] is the only available [[NTN]] test solution that differentiates between propagation emulation and fading。

來源將 effects 區分為：

| 類別 | 來源描述 |
|---|---|
| space-to-ground effects | Doppler、delay、scattering |
| terrestrial impairments | reflections、receiver-induced Doppler |

來源主張這種區分讓 space-to-ground effects and terrestrial impairments 可以 independently modeled and controlled。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：提供 satellite payload and components test and measurement solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：文件頁尾 copyright owner，© 2017–2022，地址標示 81671 Munich, Germany。
- [[R&S FSW]]：用於 group delay、linearity、NPR、signal quality、spurious、carrier-in-carrier 與 oscillator / synthesizer measurements；來源列 key features 為 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth、800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：用於 multi-carrier / modulated signal generation、OFDM waveform generation、DPD、NPR stimulus；來源列 key features 為 up to 67 GHz、up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、with [[R&S SMW-K555]] 可達 4 GHz signal bandwidth、optional second RF path up to 44 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：用於 payload components RF measurements、converter / mixer group delay、noise figure、amplifier/filter/antenna measurements；來源列 key features 包含 up to 67 GHz、up to eight independent receivers、four phase coherent sources、two internal LO sources、internal combiner。
- [[R&S FS-SNS]]：smart noise source，用於簡化 spectrum analyzer 的 noise figure and gain measurements。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]：TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 chamber 內做 inline recalibration。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：TVAC-designed three-path diode power sensors，分別支援 up to 33 GHz / 67 GHz。
- [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S RTO6]]：oscilloscopes，用於 satellite digital interface trigger、decode 與 debug。
- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]：本來源的總題目。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：比較 spectrum analyzer + signal generator 與 VNA two-tone technique 的測試主題。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下 satellite payload qualification 測試主題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]]、[[Group delay]]、[[NPR]]、[[EVM]]、[[OFDM]]、[[Spurious emissions]]、[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 與既有知識的關係

- 本來源中 [[R&S ZNA]] 的 converter / mixer、group delay、noise figure、antenna、amplifier、filter measurement use cases，補足既有 [[R&S ZNA]] 規格頁的 application context。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › Release 17：NTN baseline
[[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 明確稱 [[3GPP Release 17]] 是 NTN 的 technology baseline。

Release 17 正式將 NTN 導入 5G system specifications：

- [[IoT-NTN]]：以 [[NB-IoT]] / eMTC 為基礎的 NTN enhancement。
- [[NR-NTN]]：5G NR 對 satellite access 的 enhancement。
- FR1 S-band / L-band 中的 n255、n256 初始 bands，採 [[FDD]]。
- UE 需要 [[GNSS]] positioning 能力，以便計算 timing advance 與 Doppler precompensation。
- [[SIB19]] 導入 NTN system information，提供 satellite ephemeris、timing、reference location、validity timer 等資訊。
- PHY / MAC / RRC / NAS 各層均有 NTN adaptations，包括 time delay、Doppler shift compensation、path loss、timing advance、random access、HARQ、timer operation 與 mobility。
- MAC / HARQ 可擴充到 32 HARQ processes，並允許 disable HARQ feedback。
- RRC 層導入 NTN conditional handover。
- 架構上優先採 [[transparent payload]]，即 satellite 以 bent pipe 方式轉送，gNB 位於地面。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › 使用限制
- 本頁整理的是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 3GPP release evolution 的技術敘述；正式 normative text 仍需查各 3GPP TR / TS。
- Release 20 與 6G 內容多屬 study item、work item、proposal 或 outlook，不可視為已完成規格。
- 來源中許多 3GPP contribution / meeting paper 編號需回查原始 3GPP 文件才能確認最終狀態。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › 四種 NTN paradigms
來源將 NTN market / technology evolution 簡化為四類：

| Paradigm | 來源重點 |
|---|---|
| [[Non-3GPP satellite communications]] | 使用 proprietary / non-3GPP waveform、dedicated system architecture、dedicated ecosystem，例子是 smartphone emergency messaging。 |
| [[Direct-to-cell]] | 以 legacy smartphone 與 LTE / NR 類 radio interface 走 time-to-market approach，network / satellite 負責 time delay、Doppler 等補償；來源視為 NR-NTN fully deployed 前的 interim stage。 |
| [[IoT-NTN]] | Rel. 17+ IoT devices，基於 NB-IoT / LTE-M，使用 S-band / L-band，data rate low、delay tolerant，支援 SIB31 / SIB32。 |
| [[NR-NTN]] | 需要 Rel. 17+ new silicon UE，支援 smartphone 到 VSAT 類型，具 higher capacity、more flexibility，並作為 6G evolution trailblazer。 |

6G NTN 展望 › 使用限制
- 本頁多數內容屬 outlook、research project、study item 或 proposal，不是 finalized 6G specification。
- 來源中的 6G topics 包含 [[TR 22.870]]、[[TR 38.914]]、IMT-2030、RSPG、6G-TakeOff、6G-Coverage、6G-NTN 等多來源脈絡；正式需求需回查各文件。
- 6G waveform、security、AI、RIS、MFSS、PNT、ISAC、semantic coding 與 routing architecture 皆不可推論為現有產品功能。

6G NTN 展望 › ISAC
[[ISAC]] 將 sensing capability 整合進 communications network。

- satellite sensing 可為 active / passive、imaging / non-imaging、monostatic / bistatic / multistatic。
- ISAC 可能支援 drones、transportation、refrigerated logistics、rural sensing 等 multi-operator collaboration use cases。
- challenge 包含 high bandwidth、radar equation、power density、spectrum coexistence 與 waveform design。

6G NTN 展望 › Waveforms 與 air interface
6G NTN waveform / air interface research 包含：

- OFDMA enhancements。
- [[OTFS]]：適合 high Doppler；把 signal 轉換到 delay-Doppler domain。
- [[FDSS]]：降低 PAPR，改善 uplink-constrained NTN power efficiency；來源稱可改善 link budget 約 4 dB 到 5 dB。
- ECRA / grant-free IoT access：結合 asynchronous retransmission 與 SIC receiver，用於大量 small packet IoT access。
- circular constellation mapping、APSK、semantic coding、joint-source-channel coding。
- NOMA、full duplex、flexible TDD、multi-radio shared spectrum。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。
- Frequency setting time in list mode：依 frequency option為 `< 0.8 ms` 至 `< 1.4 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721`、run mode live 為 `< 4.0 ms`。
- Level setting range：`100 kHz ≤ f < 1 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +8 dBm`；`1 MHz ≤ f < 3 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +13 dBm`；`3 MHz ≤ f ≤ 67 GHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +30 dBm`。
- Standard performance SSB phase noise 條件：CW，carrier offset `20 kHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 Hz`，level `10 dBm` 或 maximum specified output power 兩者較低者；`f = 1 GHz` 為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`。
- `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`；在 `67 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–105 dBc`，typ. `–111 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`。
- Pulse rise/fall time（10 % / 90 % of RF amplitude）：低頻 frequency options fast transition `< 10 ns`；多數 20 GHz 以上 options fast transition `< 15 ns`；smoothed transition 多數條件 `< 200 ns`。
- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband (`R&S®SMW-B13XT`)、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。

- Market forecast 與 project examples 需回 GSMA Intelligence、operator / satellite company PR 或 regulatory filings 驗證。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › UE procedures
來源描述 NTN IoT UE procedures：

- UE determines its terrestrial position，例如 via [[GNSS]]。
- Satellite 透過 SIB broadcast 通知 orbit information、velocity、common parameters。
- UE 根據 estimated UE position 與 satellite position 計算 propagation delay。
- UE derives initial timing advance and frequency shift for first radio access。
- 依 SIB setting，UE 在 RACH procedure 期間 reports timing advance。
- 相關標準語境為 3GPP R17 / 3GPP Rel. 17 NTN-IoT。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › connection、segmentation 與 mobility
來源描述 NTN IoT long / short connections 流程：

- Deep sleep。
- GNSS acquisition。
- SIB acquisition。
- PRACH。

UE 使用 GNSS position 與 SIB info 來 precompensate timing advance 與 UL frequency。UL segmented transmission is possible，但 drawback 是 re-acquisition of GNSS + SIB and precompensation 增加 energy consumption。UE capability / network config 包含 minimum supported gap length between segments；`ntn-SegmentedPrecompensationGaps` 可為 1 symbol、1 slot、1 subframe。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

來源列出的 NTN mobility scenarios 包含：

- Cell selection / cell reselection。
- Intra-satellite / inter-beam handover。
- Inter-satellite handover / inter-satellite dual connectivity。
- NTN – terrestrial handover / dual connectivity。
- NR-NTN connection。
- Target or simultaneous dual connectivity NR-NTN connection。
- Target or simultaneous dual connectivity terrestrial connection。

5G NTN validation and testing › 與既有 NTN discovery / configuration 的關係
- [[NTN signaling customer discovery]]：用問卷釐清 service offering、test layer、release、satellite architecture、UE、QoS、mobility 與 constellation deployment；屬於需求蒐集。
- [[R&S NTN signaling solutions]]：目前主要由 customer questionnaire 支撐，代表 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 NTN signaling solution discovery 語境。
- [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]：整理 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 NR-NTN application-specific configuration guide，包含 S/L-band golden callbox、fading、mobility、Ku/Ka-band、preconformance 與 xLAPI automation。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]：補充 MWC 2024 demo / PR 語境，展示 Rel.17 [[5G NTN-NR]] connection、LEO access node emulation、voice calls 與 RF-related measurements。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]]：補充 MWC Barcelona 2026 前後的 partner-specific [[NB-NTN]] / [[NB-IoT]] IoT device certification test plan 語境，涵蓋 protocol、performance 與 RF test scenarios。
- 本頁的 PR 來源補充的是 ecosystem collaboration、validation methodology、demo / certification context，不取代需求問卷、configuration guide 或 formal specifications。

5G NTN validation and testing › 來源中的測試目標
- boost testing for [[Narrowband Non-terrestrial Networks]]（[[NB-NTN]]）[[IoT]] devices connecting via satellite。
- thoroughly validate devices and confirm interoperability with [[Viasat]] network。
- help ensure uninterrupted connectivity for satellite-based [[IoT]] applications。
- ensure chipsets、modules and devices interoperate seamlessly with [[Viasat]] satellite network。
- comply with [[3GPP Release 17]] standards。
- uphold quality、performance and reliability for [[Viasat]] connectivity services in areas without terrestrial network coverage。
- certification test plan entails protocol、performance and RF test scenarios。

5G NTN validation and testing
[[5G NTN validation and testing]] 是針對 [[5G Non-Terrestrial Networks]]、[[5G IoT-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]] 與 satellite connectivity devices，在 realistic and controlled laboratory conditions 下驗證 satellite connectivity behavior、radio channel modelling、orbit / channel emulation、protocol / performance / RF scenarios 與 system-level behavior 的測試活動。[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 補充一個 [[MWC Barcelona 2024]] 展示例子：以 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[MediaTek]] NTN-NR device as DUT 展示基於 [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications 的 live [[5G NTN-NR]] connection。[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 則補入 [[Viasat]] / [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 [[NB-NTN]] [[IoT]] certification test plan 語境，焦點是 device validation、interoperability with [[Viasat]] satellite network 與 [[3GPP Release 17]] compliance。

5G NTN validation and testing › 軌道與標準化語境
[[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]] 的標題強調 [[GEO]] and [[LEO]] NTN validation and testing；正文 quote 進一步提到 [[GEO]]、[[MEO]] and [[LEO]] satellite services。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 只明示 emulating a [[Low Earth Orbit]] satellite access node，並將展示連結到 latest [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 明示 [[3GPP Release 17]] standards 與 [[Viasat]] satellite network interoperability，但未說明 orbit、frequency bands、payload type 或 gateway architecture。

Gatehouse Satcom 來源也將 NTN 產業背景描述為 converges on standardized, [[3GPP]] based solutions，並提到 today’s [[5G NTN]] rollout 與 future [[6G NTN testing and validation]]。

Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Gatehouse Satcom]]：satellite communications software company，提供 protocol stacks、waveforms、test tools、satellite network emulation capabilities，並參與 standardized 3GPP based 5G NTN solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：test and measurement solution provider；本來源中與 [[Gatehouse Satcom]] 合作強化 NTN validation / testing。

- [[Peter Mariager]]：[[Gatehouse Satcom]] VP 5G Technology，來源中對合作意義發言。
- [[Christian Dobmeier]]：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] Director of Product Group CMX500，來源中對 GEO / MEO / LEO 5G NTN 與 future 6G NTN testing 發言。
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：本來源的核心測試概念，涵蓋 realistic lab conditions、orbit and channel emulation、satellite radio channel modelling 與 end-to-end test feedback。
- [[5G IoT-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[GEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[LEO]]、[[3GPP]]：來源明示的技術 / 軌道 / 標準化語彙。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 使用限制
- 來源是 2025 簡報，不是正式 3GPP specification 或 R&S configuration guide。
- 來源未標示正式 publication date；只見 12-2025、Last updated 08/25 與部分 workshop date。
- `All TS 38.181 Chapter X measurements supported` 是簡報宣稱，未列完整 test case IDs、software version、validation status 或 uncertainty。
- Recommended configurations 不含價格、calibration、accessories、service contract、export control 或最新 availability。
- 來源 slide 41 標題中的 `3GPP 38.181-1 v1.01` 與其他頁的 `v17.1.0` 不一致；需回原始 pptx 或 3GPP 文件確認。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › Test Models 與 FRCs
來源 slide 34 / 35 說 Chapter 6 SAN conducted transmitter characteristics 使用 Test Models（TMs），且 presets already implemented in 5G NR software options K144、K148、K171。表中列出：

- NR-SAN-FR1-TM1.1：SAN output power / radiated transmit power、occupied bandwidth、ACLR、operating band unwanted emissions、transmitter spurious emissions。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM1.2：ACLR、operating band unwanted emissions。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM2：EVM of single 64QAM PRB allocation、frequency error。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.1：total power dynamic range、frequency error、EVM for 64QAM modulation。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.2：frequency error、EVM for 16QAM modulation。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.3：frequency error、EVM for QPSK modulation。

來源 slide 36 說 Chapter 7 receiver characterization and performance measurements 使用 Fixed Reference Channels（FRCs），例如：

- QPSK, R=1/3 G-FR1-A1-1 to G-FR1-A1-9：receiver sensitivity level、ACS 等。
- 16QAM, R=2/3 G-FR1-A2-1 to G-FR1-A2-6：dynamic range。
- QPSK, R=308/1024 G-FR1-A3-1 to G-FR1-A3-6：performance requirements。
- QPSK, R=99/1024 G-FR1-A3A-1、G-FR1-A3A-3。
- Table A.4-1：PRACH test preambles。

5G NR SAN conformance testing
[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025）中針對 [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）的 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] conformance testing 應用；來源將它連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.181]]，並以 [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 signal generator / channel emulator 的核心。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 相關 3GPP specifications
依來源 slide 19 與 slide 32：

| 類別 | 來源列出的 specification | 來源描述 |
|---|---|---|
| NR SAN | [[3GPP TS 38.108]] | establishes minimum RF characteristics and minimum performance requirements of NR and NB-IoT operation in NTN NR in-band Satellite Access Node。 |
| NR SAN RF test methods | [[3GPP TS 38.181]] | specifies RF test methods and conformance requirements for NR SAN type 1-H、SAN type 1-O、SAN type 2-O，以及 NB-IoT operation in NTN NR in-band SAN type 1-H and 1-O。 |
| E-UTRA / NB-IoT SAN | [[3GPP TS 36.108]] | minimum RF characteristics and minimum performance requirements for SAN supporting standalone NB-IoT、E-UTRA 或 NB-IoT operation in NTN NR in-band。 |
| E-UTRA / NB-IoT SAN RF test methods | [[3GPP TS 36.181]] | RF test methods and conformance requirements for SAN type 1-H and SAN type 1-O。 |

來源未提供 specification version beyond several slide references to `v17.1.0`；因此版本欄位仍待正式文件補證。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › R&S SMW200A key features
依來源 slide 20，[[R&S SMW200A]] 的 SAN testing features 包含：

- FRCs。
- TMs。
- Fading Module。
- AWGN Module。
- static UE propagation models。
- TDL and moving propagation。
- SISO / MIMO。
- NB-IoT：K119 / K115 / K143 / K146。
- NR：K144 / K148 / K171。
- B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation。

來源 slide 22 將 SAN testing solution 分成：

| Configuration | 用途 |
|---|---|
| SMW B10/B14 | testing needs up to 160 MHz；full support of [[3GPP TS 38.181]] Rel. 17 SAN testing requirements；receiver and performance characteristics；support delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO。 |
| SMW B9/B15 recommended | testing needs up to 200 MHz；full support of [[3GPP TS 38.181]] Rel. 17 SAN testing requirements；receiver and performance characteristics；support delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO。 |

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 使用限制
- 本頁的 accuracy 數字與 method benefits 來自 2022 application brochure；實際性能需依 DUT、frequency range、bandwidth、SNR、option 與 calibration setup 確認。
- 本頁不取代 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 的正式規格書。
- 來源未提供完整 uncertainty budget、test limits、標準章節或 test case ID。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法一：R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A multi-carrier group delay measurement
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 與 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 可用於快速、直接量測 satellite transponders、frequency converters 與 other components 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。

衛星酬載群延遲量測
[[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]是用來判定 satellite communications transmission path phase distortions、frequency converter / transponder channel band edge distortion 與 transmission path quality 的測試方法集合。

### 建議主軸
Focus the Wireless Communication chain on 3GPP/NTN and satellite wireless testing: market needs such as controlled validation, QoS, repeatability, and compatibility with cellular/emerging wireless technologies map to measurable RF parameters such as delay, Doppler, path loss, group delay, ACLR, EVM, BER, spurious emissions, and conformance TMs/FRCs, which then map to R&S SMW200A signal-generation/channel-emulation capabilities and R&S FSW/FSVA3000 signal-analysis capabilities. [40][41][3][24][66]
### 推薦先賣
R&S SMW200A is directly linked to NTN signal generator/channel emulator use, including long path delays, enhanced Doppler capabilities, and customized dynamic fading for 5G NTN-NR testing. [2][3]
R&S FSW and R&S FSVA3000 are directly linked to SAN transmitter measurements, because 3GPP SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter-characteristics measurements require a spectrum analyzer and the source says 5G NR options on FSW/FSVA support those measurements. [24]
R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are directly recommended in the source for complete satellite payload testing, covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality. [42]
### Chain map
| Market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Satellite communication systems must support wireless communications, maintain 24/7 operation, support multi-decade longevity, maintain QoS, and remain compatible with existing cellular networks and emerging wireless technologies. [40] | Payload/component RF testing measures group delay, linearity and gain transfer, modulation accuracy, BER, EVM, OFDM behavior, spurious emissions, noise figure, and gain. [41] | R&S SMW200A is used for multi-carrier/modulated signal generation, OFDM waveform generation, DPD, and NPR stimulus, with key features up to 67 GHz, up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth, up to 4 GHz signal bandwidth with R&S SMW-K555, and optional second RF path up to 44 GHz. [44] | R&S FSW is used for group delay, linearity, NPR, signal quality, spurious, carrier-in-carrier, and oscillator/synthesizer measurements, with key features up to 90 GHz, up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers, up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth, and 800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth. [44] |
| Satellite equipment manufacturers face pressure to reduce test time/cost while uplink and downlink beam counts increase, so the test solution must be straightforward, fast, reproducible, and have high measurement performance and repeatability. [40] | Group delay is used to determine transmission-path phase distortions, channel band-edge distortion, and transmission-path quality. [96] | R&S SMW200A generates a multi-carrier continuous wave stimulus, with tone count and spacing/aperture adjustable to DUT needs, and the source lists R&S SMW-K61 for multicarrier group delay measurement. [25] | R&S FSW performs reference calibration and DUT measurement by determining carrier phase/amplitude and phase difference, and the source lists R&S FSW-K17 for the multicarrier group delay measurement application. [25] |
| 5G NTN-NR is gaining interest from chipset/device manufacturers, automotive, and satellite/space industry, initially focused on transparent payload in S/L bands and later extensions toward regenerative architecture and other bands. [2] | NTN channel emulation parameters include update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss, with E2E features including longer path delays, enhanced Doppler capabilities, and frequency-dependent atmospheric effects. [3] | R&S SMW200A with firmware version ≥ 5.30 supports B14 or B15, R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modelling, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler. [3] | The E2E NTN channel-emulation source describes SMW200A channel-emulation capabilities but does not assign a corresponding FSW/FSVA analyzer requirement for these E2E delay/Doppler/pathloss parameters. [3] |
| NTN IoT device testing must handle new fading profiles, atmospheric/weather-specific effects, high free-space path loss, and UE-side low SNR. [13] | The source gives measurable low-SNR requirements of minimum SINR ≥ −10 dB and minimum RSRP ≥ −137 dBm. [13] | R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading uses key parameters update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss, and the E2E features include frequency-dependent atmospheric effects. [3] | The NTN IoT device-testing requirement source provides SINR/RSRP and fading/path-loss requirements, but it does not state a specific signal-analyzer option or measurement configuration for them. [13] |
| SAN conformance testing targets a Satellite Access Node in transparent payload architecture and links NR SAN testing to 3GPP TS 38.108 and 3GPP TS 38.181. [23][91] | SAN transmitter TMs measure SAN output power/radiated transmit power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, operating-band unwanted emissions, transmitter spurious emissions, EVM, total power dynamic range, and frequency error. [89] | R&S SMW200A SAN testing features include FRCs, TMs, Fading Module, AWGN Module, static UE propagation models, TDL and moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, NB-IoT options K119/K115/K143/K146, NR options K144/K148/K171, and B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation. [92] | Chapter 6 conducted transmitter characteristics and Chapter 9 radiated transmitter characteristics require a spectrum analyzer, and 5G NR options on R&S FSW/R&S FSVA3000 support Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements. [24] |
| SAN receiver and performance conformance testing uses Fixed Reference Channels for receiver characterization and performance measurements. [89] | SAN FRC-based measurements include receiver sensitivity level, ACS, dynamic range, performance requirements, and PRACH test preambles. [89] | SMW B10/B14 is stated for testing needs up to 160 MHz and SMW B9/B15 for testing needs up to 200 MHz, both with support for receiver and performance characteristics, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO. [92] | The cited SAN receiver/performance passages specify the SMW signal-generation side, while the cited analyzer support is explicitly for transmitter Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements. [24][92] |
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S SMW200A Signal Generator / Channel Emulator | 5G NTN-NR testing requires long path delays, enhanced Doppler, customized dynamic fading, satellite trajectory modelling, and atmospheric effects. [2][3] | Firmware version ≥ 5.30, B14 or B15, R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading, up to 1073 ms delay, up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler, update interval/delay/Doppler/pathloss parameters. [3] | It directly implements the NTN channel-emulation parameters needed to turn satellite movement and propagation behavior into controlled lab fading files and RF impairments. [3] | [2][3] | The source is a 2025 presentation/solution summary, not a formal datasheet or price-book configuration, and recommended configurations are not a quote-ready BOM. [64] |
| R&S SMW200A for SAN signal generation | SAN conformance receiver/performance testing needs FRCs, TMs, fading, AWGN, propagation models, TDL/moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, delay, and residual Doppler support. [92] | NB-IoT options K119/K115/K143/K146, NR options K144/K148/K171, B14/B15 + K71 moving propagation, SMW B10/B14 up to 160 MHz, and SMW B9/B15 up to 200 MHz. [92] | It is explicitly described as the core signal generator/channel emulator for SAN conformance testing tied to 3GPP TS 38.108 and TS 38.181. [90][92] | [90][92] | The SAN source is a 2025 presentation, and the source warns that recommended configurations omit price, calibration, accessories, service contract, export control, and latest availability. [88] |
| R&S FSW / R&S FSVA3000 Signal Analyzer | SAN transmitter conformance requires conducted and radiated transmitter-characteristics measurements. [24] | 5G NR options on R&S FSW/R&S FSVA3000 support Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 measurements; R&S FSW signal-analysis software includes LTE, Cellular IoT, 5G NR R17/18 K171, OFDM signal analysis K96, and Vector Signal Analysis K70. [24][66] | SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 explicitly require a spectrum analyzer, and the measured items include output power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, EVM, and frequency error. [24][89] | [24][66][89] | The source notes that the FSW/FSVA 5G NR options support Chapter 6 and Chapter 9, but it does not list an FSVA3000 model or full option stack. [58] |
| R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A complete payload testing | Satellite systems need fast, reproducible testing with high measurement performance and repeatability for payloads/components. [40] | R&S SMW-K61 and R&S FSW-K17 are listed for multicarrier group delay measurement, and R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended for complete payload testing. [25][27] | The pair supports group delay measurement by generating a multicarrier stimulus and analyzing carrier phase/amplitude differences, and complete payload testing covers group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality. [25][42] | [25][42] | The group-delay accuracy and benefits come from an application brochure, and actual performance depends on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option, and calibration setup. [93] |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| NTN end-to-end RF satellite link emulation | R&S SMW200A with firmware ≥ 5.30, B14/B15, R&S SMW-K820, and optionally R&S Space Nexus fading files. [3] | Sell the chain from satellite trajectory to measurable update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss, with up to 1073 ms delay and up to ±1 MHz pure Doppler. [3] | R&S Space Nexus formal version, order number, licensing, output format, and availability conditions are not stated. [59] |
| SAN conformance receiver/performance testing | R&S SMW200A with FRCs, TMs, fading/AWGN, TDL/moving propagation, SISO/MIMO, and relevant NB-IoT/NR options. [92] | Sell the chain from 3GPP TS 38.108/38.181 SAN conformance to FRC/TM-based receiver and performance testing with delay and residual Doppler support for LEO. [91][92] | The presentation does not provide full test case IDs, validation status, uncertainty, or quote-ready configuration details. [88] |
| SAN transmitter measurements | R&S FSW or R&S FSVA3000 with 5G NR options for Chapter 6 and Chapter 9. [24] | Sell the chain from transmitter conformance to spectrum-analyzer measurements of output power, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, EVM, and frequency error. [24][89] | The source does not provide a full FSVA3000 option stack or formal configuration details. [58] |
| Satellite payload/component RF characterization | R&S SMW200A + R&S FSW. [42] | Sell the chain from satellite payload QoS/repeatability needs to group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal-quality measurements. [40][42] | The source says actual group-delay performance depends on DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, SNR, option, and calibration setup. [93] |
### 限制
The knowledge base supports Wireless Communication context through a Rohde & Schwarz presentation about EMC/regulatory test for wireless devices with 3GPP cellular technology and through satellite/NTN wireless communication testing passages, but it does not provide a single unified market-requirement document that ranks these requirements. [100][40][2]
The NTN signal-generator solution source is a presentation/solution summary, not a formal datasheet, configuration guide, price book, or standards-compliance statement. [64]
The SAN conformance source is a 2025 presentation and does not provide full test case IDs, software version, validation status, uncertainty, or quote-ready configuration details. [88]

NTN IoT device testing requirements › fading and path loss
來源指出 satellite connectivity 除 terrestrial fading profiles 外還需要 new fading profiles，包括 atmospheric fading 與 terrestrial fading 的組合，以及 rain、cloud、sun storms causing electron flow 等 weather-specific effects emulation。Large distance 造成 high free space path loss，導致 UE side low SNR。來源列出：

- Minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB。
- Minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm。
- NTN 第一階段目標為 outdoor connections。

來源未提供 3GPP clause、test condition 或 scenario profile，因此只作為測試需求線索。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 測試對象與架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 18，測試對象是 Satellite Access Node（DUT），transparent payload architecture。圖中文字包含：

- Gateway。
- NTN Payload RF。
- gNB。
- Feeder Link Emulator。
- Signal generator。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- Throughput measurement point。

來源 slide 6 說 [[3GPP]] Specification Work in Release 17 and Release 18 focuses on transparent bent-pipe payload architecture。SAN provides NR user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards NTN satellite-capable UE，connected via NG interface to 5GC，and encompasses a transparent NTN payload onboard a NTN platform、a gateway and gNB functions。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：提供 satellite payload and components test and measurement solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：文件頁尾 copyright owner，© 2017–2022，地址標示 81671 Munich, Germany。
- [[R&S FSW]]：用於 group delay、linearity、NPR、signal quality、spurious、carrier-in-carrier 與 oscillator / synthesizer measurements；來源列 key features 為 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth、800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：用於 multi-carrier / modulated signal generation、OFDM waveform generation、DPD、NPR stimulus；來源列 key features 為 up to 67 GHz、up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、with [[R&S SMW-K555]] 可達 4 GHz signal bandwidth、optional second RF path up to 44 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：用於 payload components RF measurements、converter / mixer group delay、noise figure、amplifier/filter/antenna measurements；來源列 key features 包含 up to 67 GHz、up to eight independent receivers、four phase coherent sources、two internal LO sources、internal combiner。
- [[R&S FS-SNS]]：smart noise source，用於簡化 spectrum analyzer 的 noise figure and gain measurements。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]：TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 chamber 內做 inline recalibration。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：TVAC-designed three-path diode power sensors，分別支援 up to 33 GHz / 67 GHz。
- [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S RTO6]]：oscilloscopes，用於 satellite digital interface trigger、decode 與 debug。
- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]：本來源的總題目。

- [[Noise figure measurement]]、[[Group delay]]、[[NPR]]、[[EVM]]、[[OFDM]]、[[Spurious emissions]]、[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › fading and path loss
來源指出 satellite connectivity 除 terrestrial fading profiles 外還需要 new fading profiles，包括 atmospheric fading 與 terrestrial fading 的組合，以及 rain、cloud、sun storms causing electron flow 等 weather-specific effects emulation。Large distance 造成 high free space path loss，導致 UE side low SNR。來源列出：

- Minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB。
- Minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm。
- NTN 第一階段目標為 outdoor connections。

來源未提供 3GPP clause、test condition 或 scenario profile，因此只作為測試需求線索。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

NTN IoT device testing requirements › long delay
來源指出 UE 到 satellite 的距離造成 long absolute delay：

- [[LEO]] 約 40 ms。
- [[GEO]] 約 544 ms。

Satellite orbital movement 在 connection time 期間造成 time variant delay；RTT 會因 elevation angle 與 LEO 場景而變動。RTT 相關參數包含 [[SIB31]]、K_mac、K_offset、[[SIB32]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

- GEO / GSO / LEO / MEO emulation。
- Testcase scenarios：single / multi cell、SIB31 and SIB32 support、fixed delay up to 540 ms、variable delay、Doppler +/- 50 kHz（LEO）、RF measurements view、Registration / IP / NIP / PSM / cDRX / E2E。

NB-NTN Rel.17 Test Solution products 包含：

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 與 NR-NTN conformance testing 的區分
[[NR-NTN conformance testing]] 既有頁主要整理 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]]、[[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]、[[R&S TS-RRM]]、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 UE / chipset conformance validation PR 語境。

本頁的 [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 則聚焦 [[Satellite Access Node]]、[[3GPP TS 38.108]] / [[3GPP TS 38.181]]、SAN transmitter / receiver / performance / OTA chapters，以及 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator / channel emulator 配置。兩者同屬 NTN conformance testing，但測試對象、規格與儀器角色不同。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 測試對象與架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 18，測試對象是 Satellite Access Node（DUT），transparent payload architecture。圖中文字包含：

- Gateway。
- NTN Payload RF。
- gNB。
- Feeder Link Emulator。
- Signal generator。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- Throughput measurement point。

來源 slide 6 說 [[3GPP]] Specification Work in Release 17 and Release 18 focuses on transparent bent-pipe payload architecture。SAN provides NR user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards NTN satellite-capable UE，connected via NG interface to 5GC，and encompasses a transparent NTN payload onboard a NTN platform、a gateway and gNB functions。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › Release 17：NTN baseline
[[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 明確稱 [[3GPP Release 17]] 是 NTN 的 technology baseline。

Release 17 正式將 NTN 導入 5G system specifications：

- [[IoT-NTN]]：以 [[NB-IoT]] / eMTC 為基礎的 NTN enhancement。
- [[NR-NTN]]：5G NR 對 satellite access 的 enhancement。
- FR1 S-band / L-band 中的 n255、n256 初始 bands，採 [[FDD]]。
- UE 需要 [[GNSS]] positioning 能力，以便計算 timing advance 與 Doppler precompensation。
- [[SIB19]] 導入 NTN system information，提供 satellite ephemeris、timing、reference location、validity timer 等資訊。
- PHY / MAC / RRC / NAS 各層均有 NTN adaptations，包括 time delay、Doppler shift compensation、path loss、timing advance、random access、HARQ、timer operation 與 mobility。
- MAC / HARQ 可擴充到 32 HARQ processes，並允許 disable HARQ feedback。
- RRC 層導入 NTN conditional handover。
- 架構上優先採 [[transparent payload]]，即 satellite 以 bent pipe 方式轉送，gNB 位於地面。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › 使用限制
- 本頁整理的是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 3GPP release evolution 的技術敘述；正式 normative text 仍需查各 3GPP TR / TS。
- Release 20 與 6G 內容多屬 study item、work item、proposal 或 outlook，不可視為已完成規格。
- 來源中許多 3GPP contribution / meeting paper 編號需回查原始 3GPP 文件才能確認最終狀態。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › 四種 NTN paradigms
來源將 NTN market / technology evolution 簡化為四類：

| Paradigm | 來源重點 |
|---|---|
| [[Non-3GPP satellite communications]] | 使用 proprietary / non-3GPP waveform、dedicated system architecture、dedicated ecosystem，例子是 smartphone emergency messaging。 |
| [[Direct-to-cell]] | 以 legacy smartphone 與 LTE / NR 類 radio interface 走 time-to-market approach，network / satellite 負責 time delay、Doppler 等補償；來源視為 NR-NTN fully deployed 前的 interim stage。 |
| [[IoT-NTN]] | Rel. 17+ IoT devices，基於 NB-IoT / LTE-M，使用 S-band / L-band，data rate low、delay tolerant，支援 SIB31 / SIB32。 |
| [[NR-NTN]] | 需要 Rel. 17+ new silicon UE，支援 smartphone 到 VSAT 類型，具 higher capacity、more flexibility，並作為 6G evolution trailblazer。 |

6G NTN 展望 › 使用限制
- 本頁多數內容屬 outlook、research project、study item 或 proposal，不是 finalized 6G specification。
- 來源中的 6G topics 包含 [[TR 22.870]]、[[TR 38.914]]、IMT-2030、RSPG、6G-TakeOff、6G-Coverage、6G-NTN 等多來源脈絡；正式需求需回查各文件。
- 6G waveform、security、AI、RIS、MFSS、PNT、ISAC、semantic coding 與 routing architecture 皆不可推論為現有產品功能。

6G NTN 展望 › ISAC
[[ISAC]] 將 sensing capability 整合進 communications network。

- satellite sensing 可為 active / passive、imaging / non-imaging、monostatic / bistatic / multistatic。
- ISAC 可能支援 drones、transportation、refrigerated logistics、rural sensing 等 multi-operator collaboration use cases。
- challenge 包含 high bandwidth、radar equation、power density、spectrum coexistence 與 waveform design。

6G NTN 展望 › Waveforms 與 air interface
6G NTN waveform / air interface research 包含：

- OFDMA enhancements。
- [[OTFS]]：適合 high Doppler；把 signal 轉換到 delay-Doppler domain。
- [[FDSS]]：降低 PAPR，改善 uplink-constrained NTN power efficiency；來源稱可改善 link budget 約 4 dB 到 5 dB。
- ECRA / grant-free IoT access：結合 asynchronous retransmission 與 SIC receiver，用於大量 small packet IoT access。
- circular constellation mapping、APSK、semantic coding、joint-source-channel coding。
- NOMA、full duplex、flexible TDD、multi-radio shared spectrum。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[R&S SMW200A]]：補充 NTN channel emulation、SAN conformance testing 與 E2E testing 的 application / configuration 視角；不取代 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]] 或 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]。
- 與 [[R&S FSW]]：補充在 NTN component testing 中的分析角色與簡報級摘要規格；正式 frequency / bandwidth / option 仍以 [[FSW_specs_en_5215-6749-22_v1701]] 為準。
- 與 [[R&S FSVA3000]]：補充 FSW / FSVA 5G NR options support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements 的簡報說法；未列出 FSVA3000 具體型號或 option stack。
- 與 [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：新增 signal-generator-centric / channel-emulation-centric 的 NTN validation path，與既有 CMX500 / partner PR 語境互補。
- 與 [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：既有頁偏向 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation；本來源聚焦 [[Satellite Access Node]] conformance testing 與 [[3GPP TS 38.181]] / [[3GPP TS 38.108]]。

R&S SMW200A

NTN IoT device testing requirements › 與既有知識的關係
