NTN IoT device testing requirements › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 3GPP NTN standard、NB-NTN certification plan 或 R&S formal order configuration。
- CMW500 NTN product codes 的 formal order numbers、software versions、release status 與目前可供性未由本來源完整證明。
- Delay、Doppler、SINR、RSRP、fixed delay up to 540 ms、Doppler +/- 50 kHz 等數字需回標準或正式 app note 驗證。
- Market forecast 與 project examples 需回 GSMA Intelligence、operator / satellite company PR 或 regulatory filings 驗證。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › UE procedures
來源描述 NTN IoT UE procedures：

- UE determines its terrestrial position，例如 via [[GNSS]]。
- Satellite 透過 SIB broadcast 通知 orbit information、velocity、common parameters。
- UE 根據 estimated UE position 與 satellite position 計算 propagation delay。
- UE derives initial timing advance and frequency shift for first radio access。
- 依 SIB setting，UE 在 RACH procedure 期間 reports timing advance。
- 相關標準語境為 3GPP R17 / 3GPP Rel. 17 NTN-IoT。

NTN IoT device testing requirements › connection、segmentation 與 mobility
來源描述 NTN IoT long / short connections 流程：

- Deep sleep。
- GNSS acquisition。
- SIB acquisition。
- PRACH。

UE 使用 GNSS position 與 SIB info 來 precompensate timing advance 與 UL frequency。UL segmented transmission is possible，但 drawback 是 re-acquisition of GNSS + SIB and precompensation 增加 energy consumption。UE capability / network config 包含 minimum supported gap length between segments；`ntn-SegmentedPrecompensationGaps` 可為 1 symbol、1 slot、1 subframe。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

來源列出的 NTN mobility scenarios 包含：

- Cell selection / cell reselection。
- Intra-satellite / inter-beam handover。
- Inter-satellite handover / inter-satellite dual connectivity。
- NTN – terrestrial handover / dual connectivity。
- NR-NTN connection。
- Target or simultaneous dual connectivity NR-NTN connection。
- Target or simultaneous dual connectivity terrestrial connection。

5G NTN validation and testing › 與既有 NTN discovery / configuration 的關係
- [[NTN signaling customer discovery]]：用問卷釐清 service offering、test layer、release、satellite architecture、UE、QoS、mobility 與 constellation deployment；屬於需求蒐集。
- [[R&S NTN signaling solutions]]：目前主要由 customer questionnaire 支撐，代表 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 NTN signaling solution discovery 語境。
- [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]：整理 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 NR-NTN application-specific configuration guide，包含 S/L-band golden callbox、fading、mobility、Ku/Ka-band、preconformance 與 xLAPI automation。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]：補充 MWC 2024 demo / PR 語境，展示 Rel.17 [[5G NTN-NR]] connection、LEO access node emulation、voice calls 與 RF-related measurements。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]]：補充 MWC Barcelona 2026 前後的 partner-specific [[NB-NTN]] / [[NB-IoT]] IoT device certification test plan 語境，涵蓋 protocol、performance 與 RF test scenarios。
- 本頁的 PR 來源補充的是 ecosystem collaboration、validation methodology、demo / certification context，不取代需求問卷、configuration guide 或 formal specifications。

5G NTN validation and testing › 來源中的測試目標
- boost testing for [[Narrowband Non-terrestrial Networks]]（[[NB-NTN]]）[[IoT]] devices connecting via satellite。
- thoroughly validate devices and confirm interoperability with [[Viasat]] network。
- help ensure uninterrupted connectivity for satellite-based [[IoT]] applications。
- ensure chipsets、modules and devices interoperate seamlessly with [[Viasat]] satellite network。
- comply with [[3GPP Release 17]] standards。
- uphold quality、performance and reliability for [[Viasat]] connectivity services in areas without terrestrial network coverage。
- certification test plan entails protocol、performance and RF test scenarios。

5G NTN validation and testing
[[5G NTN validation and testing]] 是針對 [[5G Non-Terrestrial Networks]]、[[5G IoT-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]] 與 satellite connectivity devices，在 realistic and controlled laboratory conditions 下驗證 satellite connectivity behavior、radio channel modelling、orbit / channel emulation、protocol / performance / RF scenarios 與 system-level behavior 的測試活動。[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 補充一個 [[MWC Barcelona 2024]] 展示例子：以 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[MediaTek]] NTN-NR device as DUT 展示基於 [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications 的 live [[5G NTN-NR]] connection。[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 則補入 [[Viasat]] / [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 [[NB-NTN]] [[IoT]] certification test plan 語境，焦點是 device validation、interoperability with [[Viasat]] satellite network 與 [[3GPP Release 17]] compliance。

5G NTN validation and testing › 軌道與標準化語境
[[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]] 的標題強調 [[GEO]] and [[LEO]] NTN validation and testing；正文 quote 進一步提到 [[GEO]]、[[MEO]] and [[LEO]] satellite services。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 只明示 emulating a [[Low Earth Orbit]] satellite access node，並將展示連結到 latest [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 明示 [[3GPP Release 17]] standards 與 [[Viasat]] satellite network interoperability，但未說明 orbit、frequency bands、payload type 或 gateway architecture。

Gatehouse Satcom 來源也將 NTN 產業背景描述為 converges on standardized, [[3GPP]] based solutions，並提到 today’s [[5G NTN]] rollout 與 future [[6G NTN testing and validation]]。

Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Gatehouse Satcom]]：satellite communications software company，提供 protocol stacks、waveforms、test tools、satellite network emulation capabilities，並參與 standardized 3GPP based 5G NTN solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：test and measurement solution provider；本來源中與 [[Gatehouse Satcom]] 合作強化 NTN validation / testing。

- [[Peter Mariager]]：[[Gatehouse Satcom]] VP 5G Technology，來源中對合作意義發言。
- [[Christian Dobmeier]]：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] Director of Product Group CMX500，來源中對 GEO / MEO / LEO 5G NTN 與 future 6G NTN testing 發言。

- [[5G IoT-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[GEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[LEO]]、[[3GPP]]：來源明示的技術 / 軌道 / 標準化語彙。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › Test Models 與 FRCs
來源 slide 34 / 35 說 Chapter 6 SAN conducted transmitter characteristics 使用 Test Models（TMs），且 presets already implemented in 5G NR software options K144、K148、K171。表中列出：

- NR-SAN-FR1-TM1.1：SAN output power / radiated transmit power、occupied bandwidth、ACLR、operating band unwanted emissions、transmitter spurious emissions。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM1.2：ACLR、operating band unwanted emissions。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM2：EVM of single 64QAM PRB allocation、frequency error。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.1：total power dynamic range、frequency error、EVM for 64QAM modulation。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.2：frequency error、EVM for 16QAM modulation。
- NR-SAN-FR1-TM3.3：frequency error、EVM for QPSK modulation。

來源 slide 36 說 Chapter 7 receiver characterization and performance measurements 使用 Fixed Reference Channels（FRCs），例如：

- QPSK, R=1/3 G-FR1-A1-1 to G-FR1-A1-9：receiver sensitivity level、ACS 等。
- 16QAM, R=2/3 G-FR1-A2-1 to G-FR1-A2-6：dynamic range。
- QPSK, R=308/1024 G-FR1-A3-1 to G-FR1-A3-6：performance requirements。
- QPSK, R=99/1024 G-FR1-A3A-1、G-FR1-A3A-3。
- Table A.4-1：PRACH test preambles。

5G NR SAN conformance testing
[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025）中針對 [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）的 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] conformance testing 應用；來源將它連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.181]]，並以 [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 signal generator / channel emulator 的核心。

依來源 slide 19 與 slide 32：

| 類別 | 來源列出的 specification | 來源描述 |
|---|---|---|
| NR SAN | [[3GPP TS 38.108]] | establishes minimum RF characteristics and minimum performance requirements of NR and NB-IoT operation in NTN NR in-band Satellite Access Node。 |
| NR SAN RF test methods | [[3GPP TS 38.181]] | specifies RF test methods and conformance requirements for NR SAN type 1-H、SAN type 1-O、SAN type 2-O，以及 NB-IoT operation in NTN NR in-band SAN type 1-H and 1-O。 |
| E-UTRA / NB-IoT SAN | [[3GPP TS 36.108]] | minimum RF characteristics and minimum performance requirements for SAN supporting standalone NB-IoT、E-UTRA 或 NB-IoT operation in NTN NR in-band。 |
| E-UTRA / NB-IoT SAN RF test methods | [[3GPP TS 36.181]] | RF test methods and conformance requirements for SAN type 1-H and SAN type 1-O。 |

來源未提供 specification version beyond several slide references to `v17.1.0`；因此版本欄位仍待正式文件補證。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › R&S SMW200A key features
依來源 slide 20，[[R&S SMW200A]] 的 SAN testing features 包含：

- FRCs。
- TMs。
- Fading Module。
- AWGN Module。
- static UE propagation models。
- TDL and moving propagation。
- SISO / MIMO。
- NB-IoT：K119 / K115 / K143 / K146。
- NR：K144 / K148 / K171。
- B14 / B15 + K71 moving propagation。

來源 slide 22 將 SAN testing solution 分成：

| Configuration | 用途 |
|---|---|
| SMW B10/B14 | testing needs up to 160 MHz；full support of [[3GPP TS 38.181]] Rel. 17 SAN testing requirements；receiver and performance characteristics；support delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO。 |
| SMW B9/B15 recommended | testing needs up to 200 MHz；full support of [[3GPP TS 38.181]] Rel. 17 SAN testing requirements；receiver and performance characteristics；support delay and residual Doppler requirements for LEO。 |

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 使用限制
- 本頁的 accuracy 數字與 method benefits 來自 2022 application brochure；實際性能需依 DUT、frequency range、bandwidth、SNR、option 與 calibration setup 確認。
- 本頁不取代 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 的正式規格書。
- 來源未提供完整 uncertainty budget、test limits、標準章節或 test case ID。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法一：R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A multi-carrier group delay measurement
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 與 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 可用於快速、直接量測 satellite transponders、frequency converters 與 other components 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。

[[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]是用來判定 satellite communications transmission path phase distortions、frequency converter / transponder channel band edge distortion 與 transmission path quality 的測試方法集合。

### 建議主軸
Focus the Wireless Communication chain on 3GPP/NTN and satellite wireless testing: market needs such as controlled validation, QoS, repeatability, and compatibility with cellular/emerging wireless technologies map to measurable RF parameters such as delay, Doppler, path loss, group delay, ACLR, EVM, BER, spurious emissions, and conformance TMs/FRCs, which then map to R&S SMW200A signal-generation/channel-emulation capabilities and R&S FSW/FSVA3000 signal-analysis capabilities. [40][41][3][24][66]
### 推薦先賣
R&S SMW200A is directly linked to NTN signal generator/channel emulator use, including long path delays, enhanced Doppler capabilities, and customized dynamic fading for 5G NTN-NR testing. [2][3]
R&S FSW and R&S FSVA3000 are directly linked to SAN transmitter measurements, because 3GPP SAN Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter-characteristics measurements require a spectrum analyzer and the source says 5G NR options on FSW/FSVA support those measurements. [24]
R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are directly recommended in the source for complete satellite payload testing, covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality. [42]
### Chain map
| Market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Satellite communication systems must support wireless communications, maintain 24/7 operation, support multi-decade longevity, maintain QoS, and remain compatible with existing cellular networks and emerging wireless technologies. [40] | Payload/component RF testing measures group delay, linearity and gain transfer, modulation accuracy, BER, EVM, OFDM behavior, spurious emissions, noise figure, and gain. [41] | R&S SMW200A is used for multi-carrier/modulated signal generation, OFDM waveform generation, DPD, and NPR stimulus, with key features up to 67 GHz, up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth, up to 4 GHz signal bandwidth with R&S SMW-K555, and optional second RF path up to 44 GHz. [44] | R&S FSW is used for group delay, linearity, NPR, signal quality, spurious, carrier-in-carrier, and oscillator/synthesizer measurements, with key features up to 90 GHz, up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers, up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth, and 800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth. [44] |
| Satellite equipment manufacturers face pressure to reduce test time/cost while uplink and downlink beam counts increase, so the test solution must be straightforward, fast, reproducible, and have high measurement performance and repeatability. NTN IoT device testing requirements › fading and path loss
來源指出 satellite connectivity 除 terrestrial fading profiles 外還需要 new fading profiles，包括 atmospheric fading 與 terrestrial fading 的組合，以及 rain、cloud、sun storms causing electron flow 等 weather-specific effects emulation。Large distance 造成 high free space path loss，導致 UE side low SNR。來源列出：

- Minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB。
- Minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm。
- NTN 第一階段目標為 outdoor connections。

來源未提供 3GPP clause、test condition 或 scenario profile，因此只作為測試需求線索。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 測試對象與架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 18，測試對象是 Satellite Access Node（DUT），transparent payload architecture。圖中文字包含：

- Gateway。
- NTN Payload RF。
- gNB。
- Feeder Link Emulator。
- Signal generator。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- Throughput measurement point。

來源 slide 6 說 [[3GPP]] Specification Work in Release 17 and Release 18 focuses on transparent bent-pipe payload architecture。SAN provides NR user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards NTN satellite-capable UE，connected via NG interface to 5GC，and encompasses a transparent NTN payload onboard a NTN platform、a gateway and gNB functions。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：提供 satellite payload and components test and measurement solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：文件頁尾 copyright owner，© 2017–2022，地址標示 81671 Munich, Germany。
- [[R&S FSW]]：用於 group delay、linearity、NPR、signal quality、spurious、carrier-in-carrier 與 oscillator / synthesizer measurements；來源列 key features 為 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth、800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：用於 multi-carrier / modulated signal generation、OFDM waveform generation、DPD、NPR stimulus；來源列 key features 為 up to 67 GHz、up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、with [[R&S SMW-K555]] 可達 4 GHz signal bandwidth、optional second RF path up to 44 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：用於 payload components RF measurements、converter / mixer group delay、noise figure、amplifier/filter/antenna measurements；來源列 key features 包含 up to 67 GHz、up to eight independent receivers、four phase coherent sources、two internal LO sources、internal combiner。
- [[R&S FS-SNS]]：smart noise source，用於簡化 spectrum analyzer 的 noise figure and gain measurements。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]：TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 chamber 內做 inline recalibration。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：TVAC-designed three-path diode power sensors，分別支援 up to 33 GHz / 67 GHz。
- [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S RTO6]]：oscilloscopes，用於 satellite digital interface trigger、decode 與 debug。
- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]：本來源的總題目。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：比較 spectrum analyzer + signal generator 與 VNA two-tone technique 的測試主題。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下 satellite payload qualification 測試主題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]]、[[Group delay]]、[[NPR]]、[[EVM]]、[[OFDM]]、[[Spurious emissions]]、[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]。
